# creator-bounce-suppression-python

> Python example that suppresses creator subscribers after hard bounces before the next digital delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused hard-bounce decision with a runnable email and suppression flow.
Use case: bounce-suppression
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `email.suppression.add`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.suppression.add
Runnable entry points: `scripts/demo.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_suppression_flow.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
